metadata.source_note: The current official State of Wyoming portal affirmatively states that Wyoming does not possess an individual or corporate income tax. The page was last updated October 16, 2025 and displays a 2026 State of Wyoming copyright. This intake supports the absence of a tax-year-2026 resident individual income tax through the pre-credit tax stage. It does not certify a complete nonrefundable-credit, refundable-credit, or signed net-liability surface, and it excludes business and entity taxes, payments, filing administration, local taxes, and nonresident allocation.

metadata.source_note: The official May 2026 Wyoming Legislative Service Office report states that Wyoming does not have a state income tax and explains that neither sweepstakes-casino operators nor players are taxed by the state. This current legislative research source corroborates the state portal's explicit individual-income-tax absence for tax year 2026. It does not certify a complete nonrefundable-credit, refundable-credit, or signed net-liability surface, and it does not establish the treatment of business or entity taxes, payments, filing administration, local taxes, or nonresident allocation.
